sanskrit_verse:
माहिष्येण करण्यां तु रथकारः प्रजायते ।
असत्सन्तस् तु विज्ञेयाः प्रतिलोमानुलोमजाः ॥९५॥
transliteration: māhiṣyeṇa karaṇyāṃ tu rathakāraḥ prajāyate | asatsantaḥ tu vijñeyāḥ pratilomānulomajāḥ || 95 ||
sph_interpretive_translation: From the union of a female buffalo with a carpenter, a chariot-maker is born; those born contrary to natural order and social capacity are to be recognized as lacking authentic existence.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with svadharma, not biological origin alone
Causation is determined by conscious intent and societal role, not mere physical lineage
Capacity-based responsibility requires recognition of one's inherent fitness for function
Restoration logic demands correction of misaligned social roles to preserve cosmic order
Consciousness alignment supersedes genetic or ritualistic determinants of identity
executable_legal_axioms: IF birth occurs outside svadharma-based procreative framework THEN individual lacks juridical standing until capacity-aligned role is assumed
IF societal function contradicts natural-social order THEN such manifestation is classified as 'asat' and subject to realignment protocols
IF individual exhibits competence in dharma-appropriate role THEN grant full juridical recognition retroactively
IF lineage conflicts with functional capacity THEN lineage data shall not determine legal status
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving caste-based rights or occupational entitlements, the Supreme Court must prioritize functional capacity and conscious alignment over hereditary claims. Authentic existence under Dharma is conferred through rightful action, not inherited status.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that true being arises from harmony between consciousness and duty. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that misaligned births result from prior disorder, necessitating realignment rather than punishment. Responsibility lies in restoring natural-social equilibrium without inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svadharma discovery process to align individual with appropriate social function
Deploy consciousness elevation practices to dissolve false identification with birth-based roles
Implement community integration rituals upon successful assumption of aligned duty
Activate ancestral rectification sequences to prevent recurrence of role-disorder in lineage
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Sole Source of Legal Reality: Dharma prevails through conscious alignment, not punitive enforcement. All beings possess the right to realign with their true function. Consciousness is the ultimate judge, and restoration is the only justice.
